task.question: The Ecuador vs Germany group stage match on June 25, 2026, at MetLife Stadium marked when the 2026 World Cup surpassed which previous World Cup's attendance record?
task.evidence: This surpassed the previous record of 3,587,538, which had been held for 32 years by the 1994 FIFA World Cup, also hosted in the United States.

The Ecuador vs Germany group stage match on June 25, 2026, at MetLife Stadium marked when the 2026 World Cup surpassed which previous World Cup's attendance record?

messages.content:
On June 25, during the Group E match between Ecuador and Germany at MetLife Stadium, total attendance reached 3,605,357 spectators.
Nearly 7 million people attended matches during the tournament, surpassing the 1994 edition to set a new record for the highest attendance in World Cup history.
June 29, 2026 4:30 p.m. UTC−4 Germany 1–1 (a.e.t.) Paraguay Havertz 54' Enciso 42' Penalties Havertz Kimmich Musiala Woltemade Amiri Tah 3–4 Maurício G. Gómez Galarza Sanabria Balbuena Canale Gillette Stadium, Foxborough Attendance: 63,945 Referee: Jalal Jayed (Morocco)
June 30, 2026 8:00 p.m. UTC−6 Mexico 2–0 Ecuador Quiñones 22' Jiménez 31' Estadio Azteca, Mexico City Attendance: 80,824 Referee: Slavko Vinčić (Slovenia)
The tournament set the record for the highest cumulative attendance in World Cup history, with a total of 6,810,966 spectators.
Across the first 60 matches, venues operated at an average occupancy rate of 99.7%. Additionally, a single-day World Cup attendance record was established on June 16, 2026, when 281,223 fans attended four group stage matches.
